blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As image generation models become increasingly capable of producing highly realistic content, traditional forensic techniques are struggling to keep up. This paper investigates whether MLLMs can instead be used as a form of forensic analysis by identifying synthetic media. Specifically, the study aims to determine whether these models detect fake images by recognising physical inconsistencies, or whether they rely on digital artefacts such as embedded watermarks.Six MLLMs: GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5, Gemini 3, and Seed 1.6, are benchmarked using a dataset of 400 images. Fifty images are authentic photographs, while the remaining 350 are generated using seven leading image models: Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, Seedream 4.0, and Seedream 4.5. The evaluation is structured in three stages: single-image classification, pairwise comparison, and a focused "self-detection" experiment on Gemini. Several MLLMs achieved a high detection accuracy, with GPT-5.2 reaching a peak of 97.9% in the pairwise experiment, against specific generators and an overall mean pairwise accuracy of 82.5% by identifying structural or physical inconsistencies within images. However, results from the self-detection experiment indicate that the presence of invisible SynthID watermarks leads to a 10% reduction in Gemini's detection accuracy compared to the clean control group. One possible explanation is that SynthID embedding reduces some of the visible artefacts the models rely on for detection.These results imply that MLLMs can detect structural artefacts without relying on watermarks, but performance varies substantially across model generations. The findings from comparison C5 also suggest that SynthID embedding may suppress some of the structural artefacts used during detection.
blocks.zh: 随着图像生成模型越来越能产生出高度现实的内容,传统的法证技术正难以跟上. 本文调查MLLMS是否可以通过识别合成介质作为法证分析的一种. 具体来说,该研究的目的是确定这些模型是否通过识别物理上的不一致来检测出假图像,或者它们是否依赖于嵌入式水印等数字手工艺品. 6个MLLMs:GPT-4o,GPT-5,GPT-5.2,双子座2.5,双子座3和种子1.6,使用由400个图像组成的数据集作为基准. 50幅相片为正版相片,而其余的350幅相片则使用7个主要相片模型生成:双子座3,双子座2.5,Flux.2 Pro,GPT-Image-1,GPT-Image-1.5,Seedream 4.0和Seedream 4.5. 评估分为三个阶段:单相图分类,对等比较,以及双相子上的重点"自测"实验. 几个MLLM实现了高检测精度,在对偶实验中,GPT-5.2相对于特定发电机达到了97.9%的峰值,通过识别图像内部的结构或物理不一致,总体平均对偶精度为82.5%. 然而,自测实验的结果表明,与清洁控制组相比,隐形合成水印的存在导致双子座检测精度降低10%. 一种可能的解释是,合成ID嵌入会减少模型检测所依赖的一些可见的手工艺品. 这些结果意味着,MLLMs可以不依赖水印来探测出结构上的手工艺品,但不同代相差很大。 比较C5的结果还表明,合成体嵌入可能会抑制在探测时使用的一些结构工艺品。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: 1.1. Background and Motivation
blocks.zh: 1.1. 背景和动机

blocks.en: Generative tools such as OpenAI’s GPT-series and Google’s Gemini-series have become increasingly advanced in their image generation capabilities. Throughout this study, the term deepfake refers to fully synthetic facial images generated from text prompts using the seven generative models: Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, Seedream 4.0, and Seedream 4.5. This study focuses specifically on fully synthetic deepfakes, images generated entirely from text prompts, rather than face-swap or identity-manipulation techniques, which involve modifying existing footage. While generative models are increasingly capable of both approaches, this study isolates text-to-image synthesis as the primary forensic threat. These models now produce images that are difficult to distinguish from real photographs. Traditional forensic methods are becoming inadequate for this task; methods that once relied on pixel-level inconsistencies ( Rössler et al., 2019 ) are becoming obsolete. Researchers have increasingly turned to MLLMs for deepfake detection, through their abilities to “justify” their detection classifications. Rather than searching for pixel artefacts, research has shown that MLLMs can identify semantic inconsistencies within images such as irregular lighting or inconsistent background geometry ( Jia et al., 2024 ) . This study evaluates whether recent models such as GPT-5.2 demonstrate similar or improved capability.
blocks.zh: OpenAI的GPT系列和Google的双子星系列等基因工具在图像生成能力上越来越先进. 在整个研究中,Deepfake一词是指利用七种基因模型:双子座3,双子座2.5,Flux2 Pro,GPT-Image-1,GPT-Image-1.5,Seedream 4.0和Seedream 4.5. 从文字提示中生成的全合成面部图像. 这项研究特别侧重于完全合成的深假,完全由文字提示生成的图像,而不是面部扫描或身份操纵技术,这些技术涉及修改现有的镜头. 虽然基因模型越来越能够采用这两种方法,但本研究将文本到图像的合成孤立为主要的法证威胁. 这些模型现在产生了难以与真实照片区分的图像. 传统的法医学方法正变得不足以完成这项任务;曾经依赖像素水平不一致的方法(Rössler等人,2019年)逐渐过时. 研究人员越来越多地利用MLLMs进行深层假探测,因为他们有能力“说明”其探测分类。 研究显示,MLLMS可以识别不规则照明或不一致的背景几何等图像中的语义不一致(Jia等人,2024年)。 本研究评价了最近的模型,如GPT-5.2是否显示出类似或改进的能力.

blocks.en: While MLLM decision justification represents a promising step for Explainable AI (XAI), these models remain unpredictable in their classification behaviour. Lapuschkin et al. ( Lapuschkin et al., 2019 ) and Maheronnaghsh ( Maheronnaghsh and Alvanagh, 2025 ) highlight the “Clever Hans” effect, when a model achieves high accuracy by exploiting shortcuts within the image rather than a genuine forensic understanding. These shortcuts often stem from the generator’s traces such as visible logos or pixel-embedded watermarks such as Google’s SynthID.
blocks.zh: 虽然MLLM决定的理由是解释性AI(AI)的一个很有希望的步骤,但这些模型的分类行为仍然难以预测。 Lapuschkin 等人著. (Lapuschkin等人,2019年)和Maheronnaghsh(Maheronnaghsh和Alvanagh,2025年)强调了“Clever Hans”效应,当一个模型通过利用图像中的捷径而不是真正的法证理解来达到高精度时。 这些快捷键往往来源于生成器的痕迹,如可见的标志或像素嵌入的水印,如Google合成ID.

blocks.en: This study assesses the reliability of MLLMs as forensic detectors. By isolating and removing generator-related traces within Experiment 3, and comparing detection performance across conditions in Experiments 1 and 2, this study examines the extent to which MLLM accuracy may depend on structural image artefacts or digital shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 这项研究评估了MLLMs作为法医探测器的可靠性. 通过在实验3中隔离和清除与发电机有关的痕迹,并比较实验1和2中各种条件的探测性能,本研究考察了MLLM精确度可能取决于结构图像工艺品或数字快捷键的程度.

blocks.en: Central to this research is the audit of MLLM decision-making. It remains unclear whether MLLMs genuinely reason about image structure or whether high accuracy reflects exploitation of digital shortcuts, such as metadata cues or pixel-embedded watermarks, rather than genuine forensic analysis ( Maheronnaghsh and Alvanagh, 2025 ; Ji et al., 2025 ) . Current evidence is not yet sufficient to answer this question, motivating the controlled experimental design used in this study.
blocks.zh: 这一研究的核心是对劳动、劳动、劳工和劳工部的决策进行审计。 仍然不清楚的是,MLLMs是真实的图像结构理由,还是高精度反映了对诸如元数据提示或像素嵌入水印等数字快捷方式的利用,而不是真正的法证分析(Maheronnaghsh和Alvanagh,2025年;Ji等人,2025年)。 目前的证据尚不足以回答这一问题,从而推动了本研究中使用的控制实验设计。

blocks.en: 1.2. Research Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 1.2. 研究假设

blocks.en: To achieve this, the following four Hypotheses have been established:
blocks.zh: 为此,确定了以下四个假设:

blocks.en: • H1 (Self- and Cross-Model Detection): Generative ecosystems may have an advantage in detecting their own generated images, however, detection performance against images from external models is expected to vary significantly across architectures ( Ji et al., 2025 ) . • H2 (Pairwise Image Advantage): Detection accuracy is theoretically higher in a pairwise experiment, where the MLLM is presented with one real and one fake image simultaneously, than in a single-image experiment ( Jia et al., 2024 ; Chandra et al., 2025 ) . • H3 (Effects of Watermarks): The presence or absence of watermark signals will have a measurable effect on detection accuracy ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ) . • H4 (Justification Reliability): MLLM natural-language justifications may not accurately reflect the reasoning process, raising concerns about whether MLLM justifications are genuine structural analysis ( Maheronnaghsh and Alvanagh, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: • H1(自行和跨模式探测): 基因生态系统在探测自己生成的图像方面可能具有优势,但预计对照外部模型的图像进行探测的性能会因各种架构而有很大差异(Ji等人,2025年) ^ H2(平面图像优点):在理论上,在对面实验中检测精度较高,在对面实验中,MLLM同时呈现一个真实和一个假图像,比在单面图像实验中检测精度更高(Jia等人,2024年;Chandra等人,2025年) ^ H3(水印的影响): 是否存在水印信号将对检测准确性产生可衡量的影响(Liu等人,2024年;Han等人,2025年)。 MLLM自然语言的理由可能不能准确地反映推理过程,引起人们对MLLM的理由是否是真正的结构分析的担忧(Maheronnaghsh和Alvanagh,2025年)。

blocks.en: H1 (Self- and Cross-Model Detection): Generative ecosystems may have an advantage in detecting their own generated images, however, detection performance against images from external models is expected to vary significantly across architectures ( Ji et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: H1(自行和跨模式检测): 基因生态系统在探测自己生成的图像方面可能具有优势,但预计对照外部模型的图像进行探测的性能在各种结构中差异很大(Ji等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: H2 (Pairwise Image Advantage): Detection accuracy is theoretically higher in a pairwise experiment, where the MLLM is presented with one real and one fake image simultaneously, than in a single-image experiment ( Jia et al., 2024 ; Chandra et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: H3 (Effects of Watermarks): The presence or absence of watermark signals will have a measurable effect on detection accuracy ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: H3(水印的影响): 是否存在水印信号将对检测准确性产生可衡量的影响(Liu等人,2024年;Han等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: H4 (Justification Reliability): MLLM natural-language justifications may not accurately reflect the reasoning process, raising concerns about whether MLLM justifications are genuine structural analysis ( Maheronnaghsh and Alvanagh, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: H4(合理可靠性): MLLM自然语言的理由可能不能准确地反映推理过程,引起人们对MLLM的理由是否是真正的结构分析的担忧(Maheronnaghsh和Alvanagh,2025年)。

blocks.en: 1.3. Research Objectives
blocks.zh: 1.3. 研究目标

blocks.en: These hypotheses are further reinforced within the following objectives evaluated throughout the study: • Dataset Construction: Building a custom 400-image corpus, 50 authentic photographs from the Flickr-Faces-HQ dataset ( Karras et al., 2019 ) in conjunction with 350 images from seven top-ranked generators, including the Gemini Ecosystem, GPT family, Flux and SeeDream. • Detector Performance: Evaluating six MLLM detectors across single-image and pairwise classification experiments. • Gemini Watermark Experiments: Performing an “ablation” experiment on the Gemini generated images by removing their visible logos and SynthID embedded watermarks to measure how this affects detection accuracy. • Model Justification Audit: Manually validating the natural-language justifications provided by the model to determine if their justifications are reasonable or if they are “hallucinating” artefacts within the image.
blocks.zh: • 数据集建设: 打造定制400图像元件,50张真实照片来自Flickr-Faces-HQ数据集(Karras等人,2019年),与来自双子座生态系统,GPT家族,Flux和SeeDream等7个顶级发电机的350张图像结合. • 探测器性能: 评估6个MLLM探测器跨越单像和对等分类实验. • 双子水印实验: 在双子星生成的图像上进行“放大”实验,删除其可见的标志和合成器嵌入水印,以衡量这如何影响探测准确性。 • 示范说明 审计:手动验证模型提供的自然语言理由,以确定其理由是否合理,或是否在图像中“吸入”手工艺品。

blocks.en: 2. Literature Review
blocks.zh: 2. 文学评论

blocks.en: Generative AI ecosystems such as Gemini and the GPT family can now produce media that is genuinely difficult to detect. Successful detection now requires techniques such as the use of MLLMs as opposed to conventional pixel-based algorithms.
blocks.zh: 基因AI生态系统如双子座和GPT家族现在可以产生真正难以检测的媒体. 现在成功检测需要使用MLLMs等技术,而不是常规的以像素为基础的算法.

blocks.en: 2.1. Evolution of Generative AI
blocks.zh: 2.1. Generative AI的演变

blocks.en: Within the early days of generative media, it relied heavily on deep learning architectures such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) which produced media that was easily detectable both through the human eye and AI. The introduction of pre-trained language models such as BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) set the foundation for advanced language models. This was then further developed through Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) which produced high-resolution images through a denoising technique and Large Vision Models (LVMs), which extended this to visual understanding. This has led to the formation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) which are capable of processing both text and image inputs.
blocks.zh: 在基因介质的早期,它大量依赖深层的学习架构,如基因对抗网络(GANs)(Goodfellow等人,2014年),它产生了既通过人眼又通过AI容易被察觉的介质. BERT(Devlin等人,2019年)等预训语言模型的引入为高级语言模型奠定了基础. 随后通过Lententnt Difusion Models (LDMs) (Rombach 等人, 2022年) 进一步开发了此功能,该模型通过调试技术和大视野模型(LVMs)生成了高分辨率的图像,后者将此功能扩展到视觉理解. 这导致形成了能够同时处理文本和图像输入的多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs).

blocks.en: 2.2. Historical Overview of Deepfakes
blocks.zh: 2.2. 深假历史概览

blocks.en: Deepfakes have evolved through several generations, the first being video-based face-swap techniques ( Rössler et al., 2019 ) which produced visible artefacts detectable by pixel-level analysis. The second generation improved realism through GAN-based models to generate synthetic facial images. The third generation, introduced by ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , generated high-fidelity images from textual prompts with a significant decline in detectable inconsistencies, enabled by LDMs. The most recent generation involves MLLMs generating images from multimodal prompts, further reducing image detectability ( Ricker et al., 2024 ) . This study focuses on the third and fourth generations of synthetic media however, deepfake videos remain a significant concern.
blocks.zh: 深假历经几代人演化,第一代是基于视频的面部扫描技术(Rössler等人,2019年),它产生了通过像素级分析可探测到的可见文物. 第二代通过基于GAN的模型来改进现实主义,生成合成面部图像. 第三代由(Rombach等人,2022年)引入,从文字提示产生高真实度的图像,可察觉的不一致显著下降,由LDMs实现. 最近一代涉及MLLMs从多式联运提示中生成图像,进一步降低了图像的可探测性(Ricker等人,2024年)。 然而,深层假象仍然是令人严重关切的问题。

blocks.en: 2.3. Automated Deepfake Detection
blocks.zh: 2.3. 自动深层探测

blocks.en: As generative quality has significantly improved, detection strategies have shifted to high-level semantic evaluation. MLLMs have increasingly been applied to zero-shot deepfake classification. Jia et al. ( Jia et al., 2024 ) demonstrated that models within the GPT and Gemini families could identify artificial media by identifying inconsistencies within the image, rather than depending on pixel-level artefacts. These models may detect issues such as inconsistent lighting or unrealistic object structures.
blocks.zh: 随着基因质量的显著提高,检测策略已转向高级语义评价. MCLMs越来越多地应用于零射深假分类. 贾等. (Jia等人,2024年)证明GPT和双子座家族内部的模型可以通过识别图像中的不一致,而不是依赖于像素级的手工艺品来识别人工介质. 这些模型可能会发现不一致的照明或者不切实际的物体结构等问题.

blocks.en: Although the idea of using MLLMs as deepfake detectors initially seemed promising, newer studies have produced contradictory results. Large-scale testing has revealed that although they show some baseline detection capability, models experience a large drop in accuracy when tested against high-quality, real, diffusion images ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Chandra et al., 2025 ) . In addition, Jia et al. ( Jia et al., 2024 ) argued that the current MLLMs are not yet reliable enough for forensic detection, demonstrating that even a slight image alteration can drastically alter their judgement. These inconsistent findings suggest that the models tested were likely looking for visual shortcuts rather than genuine forensic reasoning.
blocks.zh: 虽然最初将MLLMs用作深假探测器的想法似乎很有希望,但较新的研究产生了相互矛盾的结果. 大规模的测试表明,虽然模型显示出一些基线检测能力,但在测试高质量、真实、扩散的图像时,其准确度大幅下降(Ren等人,2025年;Chandra等人,2025年)。 此外,贾等也. (Jia等人,2024年)认为,目前的MLLM还不足以进行法证检测,表明即使是轻微的图像改变也能急剧改变他们的判断. 这些不一致的调查结果表明,所测试的模型可能寻求视觉捷径,而不是真正的法证推理。

blocks.en: Specifically, no recent study has used a controlled ablation design to isolate whether the accuracy of MLLM detection reflects genuine structural reasoning or the exploitation of watermarks, which this study directly addresses within Experiment 3.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,最近没有一项研究使用有控制的减速设计来隔离MLLM检测的精度是否反映了真正的结构推理或水印的开发,本研究直接针对实验3.

blocks.en: 2.4. Watermarks and Their Importance
blocks.zh: 2.4. 水印及其重要性

blocks.en: Due to the increased challenges created by modern generative models, digital watermarks are increasingly promoted as a practical detection solution. Traditional image metadata can be easily manipulated by the user. Therefore, image watermarking techniques work through embedding signals directly into the image architecture ( Evsutin and Dzhanashia, 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于现代基因模型带来的更多挑战,数字水印作为实用检测解决方案日益被推广. 传统的图像元数据很容易被用户操纵. 因此,图像水标技术通过将信号直接嵌入图像架构(Evsutin和Dzhanashia,2022年)来发挥作用.

blocks.en: Google DeepMind’s SynthID is a leading example of this technology. Gowal et al. ( Gowal et al., 2025 ) outlined how the tool embeds an invisible digital signature directly into the image’s frequency domain, theoretically overcoming the traditional trade-off between visual quality and signal strength ensuring the watermark persists even through common image transformations such as cropping or compression. According to DeepMind’s developers, this ensured that even if an image is altered, the watermark remained detectable ( Dathathri et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: Google DeepMind 的合成 ID是这一技术的主要例子. 戈瓦尔等人. (Gowal等人,2025年)概述了工具如何将无形的数字签名直接嵌入图像的频率域,理论上克服了视觉质量和信号强度之间的传统权衡,确保水印即使通过裁剪或压缩等常见的图像转换也能持续下去. DeepMind的开发者认为,这确保了即使改变一个图像,水印仍然可以探测(Dathari等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: However, recent security audits have shown that embedded signals are far more fragile than the industry seems to claim. Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2024 ) found that invisible watermarks, such as systems similar to SynthID, could still be targeted by attackers through a “controllable regeneration” attack. This method removes hidden patterns without compromising the quality of the image. Han et al. ( Han et al., 2025 ) explained this weakness, finding that even basic image alterations can cause SynthID signals to deteriorate. Relying on embedded watermarks alone therefore creates a vulnerability to the Trace Removal Attack (TRA) described by Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , enabling attackers to generate seemingly real fakes that bypass modern detection systems.
blocks.zh: 然而,最近的安全审计表明,嵌入式信号比业界似乎声称的要脆弱得多。 刘等. (Liu等人,2024年)发现,隐形水印,如类似合成ID的系统,仍然可以通过“可控再生”攻击成为攻击者的目标。 这种方法在不损害图像质量的情况下去除隐藏的图案. 韩等. (Han et al.,2025)解释了这一弱点,发现即使是基本的图像改变也会导致合成ID信号恶化. 因此,仅依靠嵌入式水印就容易受到刘等人描述的追踪清除攻击。 (Liu et al., 2022),使攻击者能够产生表面上真实的假象,绕过现代的探测系统.

blocks.en: 2.5. Explainability and Justification Quality
blocks.zh: 2.5. 可解释性和合理性

blocks.en: MLLM usage has noticeably increased due to their Explainable AI (XAI) capabilities, providing natural language justifications alongside their classifications ( Li et al., 2025b ) . Knowing why a classification was made is arguably as important as the classification itself, especially in forensic scenarios ( Qian et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于其解释性人工智能(AI)的能力,MLLM的使用明显增加,除了分类之外,还提供了自然语言的理由(Li等人,2025年b)。 了解为什么进行分类,可以说与分类本身同样重要,特别是在法医假设中(Qian等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: However, analysing these explanations exposes a major flaw: the “Clever Hans” effect. Maheronnaghsh and Alvanagh ( Maheronnaghsh and Alvanagh, 2025 ) argued that MLLMs often achieve high accuracy scores not because of their capabilities to recognise facial anomalies but instead “cheat” through finding visual shortcuts within the testing data to find the correct answer. Ji et al. ( Ji et al., 2025 ) demonstrated self-detection bias, explained that while these models had higher success in recognising fakes built through their own architecture, they struggle against previously unseen diffusion models and rely on irrelevant visual traces to make a guess.
blocks.zh: 然而,分析这些解释暴露了一个重大缺陷:“Clever Hans”效应。 Maheronnaghsh和Alvanagh(Maheronnaghsh和Alvanagh,2025年)认为,MLLMs往往能达到高精度分数,不是因为它们能够识别面部异常,而是通过在测试数据中找到可视捷径来找到正确的答案而“发热”。 姬等编. (Ji等人,2025年)展示了自我探测的偏差,解释说虽然这些模型在识别通过自身架构制造的假象方面有更高的成功,但它们与之前所未见的传播模型斗争,依靠无关的视觉痕迹来猜测.

blocks.en: Beyond the models taking shortcuts, a second problem has emerged: LLM hallucinations. When asked to justify a decision, they can often fabricate supporting evidence. Both Sun et al. ( Sun et al., 2025 ) and Li et al. ( Li et al., 2025a ) demonstrated that models will confidently output factually incorrect descriptions. An example seen is the model flagging a non-existent distortion that simply is not evident within the image. Rather than the model performing true analysis, it has actually constructed a believable but fabricated justification. To extensively test the model’s reasoning capabilities, a Two-Alternative Forced Choice (TAFC) framework ( Green and Swets, 1966 ) has been adopted within this study.
blocks.zh: 除了采取捷径的模型之外,还出现了第二个问题:LLM幻觉. 当被要求证明某项决定是合理的时,他们往往可以捏造证明证据。 两者皆为太阳等. (Sun等人,2025年)和Li等人著. (Li等人,2025年a)表明,模型将充满信心地输出事实上不正确的描述。 所看到的一个例子是,模型标出一种根本不存在的扭曲,而这种扭曲在图像中并不明显。 与其说是进行真实分析的模型,它实际上已经构建了一个可信但却是捏造的理由。 为了广泛检验模型的推理能力,在本研究中采用了一种 " 双代强迫选择 " 框架(Green and Swets, 1966年)。

blocks.en: 2.6. Ethics, Diversity and Industry Context
blocks.zh: 2.6. 道德、多样性和行业背景

blocks.en: How a dataset is constructed directly affects what a detection model learns to look for ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Dataset bias is a relevant problem within digital forensics as it limits the models’ ability to evaluate diverse demographic groups accurately ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . Widely available datasets such as FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) remain the industry standard for training Generative AI; researchers must also acknowledge that FFHQ does not accurately represent certain age groups or ethnic backgrounds with approximately 70% of images featuring Caucasian individuals ( Luccioni et al., 2023 ) . Bias towards certain age brackets, ethnic backgrounds, and environmental lighting directly leads to higher false-positive rates for under-represented groups.
blocks.zh: 数据集是如何构建的,直接影响检测模型学习寻找的内容(张等人,2024年). 数据集偏差是数字法医学中的一个相关问题,因为它限制了模型准确评价不同人口群体的能力(Lin等人,2024年)。 广泛可用的数据集如FFHQ(Karras等人,2019年)仍然是培养Generative AI的行业标准;研究者也必须承认FFHQ并不准确代表某些年龄段或种族背景,大约70%的图像以高加索人为主角(Luccioni等人,2023年). 某些年龄、族裔背景和环境照明方面的偏见直接导致任职人数不足群体的虚假阳性率较高。

blocks.en: The synthetic corpus was designed using a prompt matrix to ensure demographic variance across age, gender, ethnicity and professional job roles to reduce the possibility of stereotypical outputs. Similarly, the FFHQ control group images were manually selected to ensure the evaluation framework did not favour any particular demographic profile. Together, the diverse prompt matrix and the selection of FFHQ images were implemented to avoid demographic shortcuts that can make MLLMs unreliable forensic tools.
blocks.zh: 合成体的设计采用了一个即时矩阵,以确保不同年龄、性别、族裔和专业工作角色的人口差异,以减少陈规定型产出的可能性。 同样,FFHQ控制组图象是人工选择的,以确保评价框架不偏向任何特定的人口概况. 各种快速矩阵和FFHQ图像的选择一起实施,以避免人口学捷径,使MLLMS不可靠的法证工具.

blocks.en: 3. Methodology and Implementation
blocks.zh: 3个 方法和执行情况

blocks.en: This section outlines the methodology and implementation choices applied across three experiments. Each experiment is designed to address one or more of the four hypotheses established in Section 1 . A concern across all experiments is the distinction between self-model detection, where a detector evaluates images generated by its own ecosystem, and cross-model detection, where a detector evaluates images from an external generator. This self-/cross-model comparison is integrated into experiments 1 and 2 through the full 6×7 detector-generator matrix, and is the primary focus of H1.
blocks.zh: 本节概述适用于三项试验的方法和执行选择。 每个实验旨在解决第1节所确立的四个假设中的一个或多个假设。 所有实验都关心自我模型检测与交叉模型检测之间的区别,前者是检测器评价自己生态系统产生的图像,后者是检测器评价外部生成器产生的图像。 通过完整的6×7探测器-生成器矩阵将这种自/跨模型比较纳入实验1和2,是H1的主要焦点.

blocks.en: The structure of this methodology is illustrated below within Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 下文图1说明了这一方法的结构。

blocks.en: Figure 1 . Methodological Framework: The logical progression from data sourcing (FFHQ and AI Generators) through the three-tiered experimental structure, concluding with the qualitative audit for Experiment 1 justifications.
blocks.zh: 图1 方法学 框架 : 从数据来源(FFHQ和AI生成器)到三级实验结构的逻辑进展,最后对实验1的理由进行定性审计。

blocks.en: 3.1. Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1. 数据集建设

blocks.en: All materials, including the datasets, used in this study are available at: https://github.com/OliviaSalamon/dissertation-corpus .
blocks.zh: 本研究中使用的所有材料,包括数据集,可查阅:https://github.com/OliviaSalamon/论文-公司。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Prior testing for this study revealed a significant problem to overcome: images generated by older models, such as Gemini 1.5, contained inconsistencies that would result in the MLLMs classifying them as AI-generated, such as overly smooth skin textures or unusually perfectly glossed image backgrounds ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 先前对这项研究的测试揭示了一个需要克服的重大问题:旧模型产生的图像,如双子座1.5,含有不一致之处,会导致MLLMs将其归类为AI生成,例如皮肤纹理过于光滑或图像背景异常完美(Rombach等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: The dataset was constructed in three stages. First, a synthetic corpus of 350 images was generated across seven leading generators, each generator providing a pool of 50 images, using a structured prompt matrix. Second, the prompt matrix was designed using a diversity-guided Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) framework to prevent stereotypical outputs. Third, a manually selected control group of 50 authentic photographs was sourced from FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 数据集分三个阶段构建. 首先,通过7个主要发电机生成350幅图像的合成体,每个发电机利用结构化的快速矩阵提供50幅图像。 第二,利用以多样性指导的平等、多样性和包容框架设计了快速矩阵,以防止陈规定型产出。 第三,从FFHQ(Karras等人,2019年)获得50张真实照片的手工选择控制组。

blocks.en: 3.1.1. Synthetic Corpus Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1.1. 合成公司生成

blocks.en: To overcome this limitation, a custom 400-image dataset was constructed, 350 of which were generated using seven state-of-the-art text-to-image generators. The models selected for this study were ranked among the top performers on the Artificial Analysis Text to Image Leaderboard ( Artificial Analysis, 2025 ) at the time of dataset creation (December 2025). The seven generators used within this study were: Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, Seedream 4.0, and Seedream 4.5.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这一限制,建造了一个自定义的400图像数据集,其中350个是使用7个最先进的文本到图像生成器生成的. 本研究选用的模型在数据集创建时(2025年12月)在"人工分析文本到图像导板(人工分析,2025年)"上被评为最佳表演者之一. 本研究使用的7台发电机分别为:双子座3,双子座2.5,Flux.2 Pro,GPT-Image-1,GPT-Image-1.5,Seedream 4.0和Seedream 4.5.

blocks.en: All 350 images were generated via each generator’s official developer API, the generation scripts are provided in the project corpus
blocks.zh: 所有350幅图像都是通过每个生成器的官方开发者API生成的,生成脚本在项目目录中提供

blocks.en:
( 01_Pre_Experimental_Setup/generate_images_master_script.py ).
Generating these images through APIs ensured a baseline without UI-specific watermarks, user-interface alterations, or image compression that can result from web interface generation. The only exception to this API-only pipeline occurs in Experiment 3, where additional images were specifically generated using the Gemini Web Interface to capture the visible logo watermark for comparative ablation testing.
blocks.zh:
(01_Pre_Experimental_Setup/generate_images_master_script.py.) (中文(简体) ).
通过API生成这些图像,确保了没有UI特定水印,用户界面修改,或图像压缩的基线,这些可以由网页界面生成. 这个仅API的管道的唯一例外发生在实验3中,实验3中专门利用双子座网络接口生成更多的图像,以捕捉可见的标志水印,用于比较衰竭测试.

blocks.en: 3.1.2. Prompt Matrix Design
blocks.zh: 3.1.2. 快速矩阵设计

blocks.en:
A structured prompt matrix (full prompt matrix is available in the project corpus at
( 01_Pre_Experimental_Setup/project_prompts.csv ), was constructed to ensure tests across the different models remain consistent. This was established to prevent stereotypical outputs that would directly impact detection rates of the images ( Luccioni et al., 2023 ) . To mitigate this, a dynamic prompt structure was used to ensure contextual variance within variables such as age, gender, physical traits, ethnicity, and professional roles were embedded into each of the 50 prompts within the prompt matrix. For example, prompts included: ‘A professional headshot of a woman in her 50s with grey hair, natural window light, centred composition’ and ‘A teenage boy with South Asian features, casual outdoor setting, overcast lighting.’
In addition to contextual variance, photograph background bias was further mitigated by applying consistent photographic qualifiers, such as “natural window light” and “centred composition”. The prompt matrix was designed to prevent any demographic shortcuts the generator models might rely on.
blocks.zh:
结构化的即时矩阵(项目表中有完整的即时矩阵)
(01_Pre_Experiental_Setup/project_project_promts.csv),建造是为了确保不同模型的测试始终保持一致. 建立这一机制是为了防止将直接影响图像探测率的陈规定型产出(Luccioni等人,2023年)。 为了缓解这种情况,使用了动态即时结构,以确保将年龄、性别、物理特征、族裔和专业角色等变量内的背景差异纳入即时矩阵中的50个即时结构。 例如: " 一个50多岁的妇女身着灰色头发、自然窗口灯光、中心成分的专业头部镜头 " 和 " 一个具有南亚特色的少年男孩、临时户外布置、外挂灯光。 ' ' 说
除了背景差异外,通过采用一致的摄影修饰语,如“天然窗口灯光”和“中心成分”,进一步减少了照片背景偏差。 快速矩阵旨在防止生成器模型可能依赖的人口学捷径。

blocks.en: 3.1.3. Real Image Control Group
blocks.zh: 3.1.3. 真实图像控制组

blocks.en: A control group of 50 authentic images of human faces was sourced from the Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) dataset ( Karras et al., 2019 ) . FFHQ was selected for a few main reasons: its images are taken under real-world conditions at high resolution (1024×1024) making them a representative and authentic baseline. In addition, its portrait composition is directly comparable to AI-generated head shots. However, the base FFHQ dataset is known to be heavily demographically biased, consisting of nearly 70% Caucasian and only 4.2% Black individuals ( Luccioni et al., 2023 ) . To mitigate this, images were manually selected to guarantee a balance of age groups, genders and ethnicities. This purposeful sampling prevented the AI detectors from using demographic features as a classification shortcut.
blocks.zh: 来自Flickr-Faces-HQ(FFHQ)数据集(Karras et al., 2019)的50幅人脸真实图像控制组. FFHQ被选中有几个主要原因:它的图像是在现实条件下高分辨率拍摄的(1024×1024),使得它们成为具有代表性和真实性的基线. 此外,其肖像构成与AI生成的头部镜头直接相当. 然而,据了解,FFHQ的基础数据集在人口结构上存在严重偏差,由近70%的高加索人和只有4.2%的黑人个人组成(Luccioni等人,2023年)。 为了减轻这种情况,人工挑选了图像,以保证年龄组、性别和族裔之间的平衡。 这种有目的的取样使人工智能探测器无法使用人口特征作为分类捷径。

blocks.en: 3.2. Experimental framework
blocks.zh: 3.2. 试验框架

blocks.en: To evaluate the forensic capabilities of the chosen MLLMs, a three-tiered framework was developed with each experiment designed to address specific hypotheses. Experiment 1 (single-image zero-shot classification) provides the baseline detection data required to evaluate H1 (Self- and Cross-Model Detection) and H4 (Justification Reliability). Experiment 2, pairwise TAFC classification, is designed to test H2 (Pairwise Image Advantage) by comparing accuracy against the Experiment 1 baseline. Experiment 3 (Gemini watermark ablation) directly addresses H3 (Effects of Watermarks) by isolating the contribution of visible and invisible watermark signals to detection accuracy.
blocks.zh: 为了评估所选择的MLLMs的法证能力,在每一个实验中都制定了三级框架,旨在解决具体的假设。 实验1(单镜零发分类)提供了评价H1(自测和跨模测)和H4(合理可靠性)所需的基线检测数据. 实验2,双向TAFC分类,通过比较实验1基准的精度,设计测试H2(Pairwise Image Advantage). 实验3(Gemini watermark explocation)通过隔离可见和看不见的水印信号对检测精度的贡献,直接解决H3(Watermarks的影响).

blocks.en: 3.2.1. Experiment 1: Single-Image Classification
blocks.zh: 3.2.1. 试验 1:单一形象分类

blocks.en: The first experiment was designed to establish a zero-shot baseline. In this experiment, each MLLM was presented with a single image, randomly drawn from either the 50 authentic FFHQ images or from one of seven generator-specific pools, each containing 50 images produced by a single generator.
blocks.zh: 第一次实验旨在建立零射线基线. 在这个实验中,每个MLLM都呈现出一个单一的图像,随机从50个真实的FFHQ图像或7个发电机专用集合中的一个中抽取,每个集合包含一个发电机产生的50个图像.

blocks.en:
Building directly onto the single-image classification within Experiment 1 and to move testing beyond a binary result (1 for correct classification, 0 for incorrect classification) this phase of Experiment 1 focuses on an automation script to investigate the “black box” of AI decision-making ( Qian et al., 2025 ) . Phase B extracts the natural-language justifications provided by each MLLM, forming the evidence base for the H4 (Justification Reliability) evaluation. The validity of these justifications is assessed in Phase C. This consisted of a subset of 10 fixed images (5 real images from the FFHQ dataset and 5 AI-generated images).
This subset size was selected to allow five independent classification runs per image per model, producing 50 data points per model for consistent analysis while remaining feasible for the Manual Justification Audit process outlined below in Phase C. The five AI-generated images were drawn from four distinct generator sources: Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1.5, Gemini 3, and GPT-Image-1, to ensure the reasoning evaluation was carried across the top modern generation architectures. By presenting the same ten images to each model across five independent runs, this phase tested whether each model produced consistent reasoning for identical inputs; inconsistent justifications across runs would highlight inaccuracies within detection rather than genuine structural analysis. As the MLLMs outputted their reasoning in a structured JSON format, the script allowed for analysis to check whether visible or invisible watermark signals were referenced in the model’s text outputs.
blocks.zh:
实验1的这一阶段侧重于自动化脚本,以调查AI决策的“黑匣子”(Qian等人,2025年)。 阶段 B摘录了每个MLLM提供的自然语言理由,构成了H4(合理可靠性)评价的证据基础. C阶段评估这些理由的有效性。 这包括一个由10个固定图像组成的子集(5个来自FFHQ数据集的真实图像和5个AI生成的图像).
选择这一子集规模是为了允许每个模型每个图像进行五个独立分类,每个模型产生50个数据点,以便进行一致分析,同时对下文C阶段概述的《说明理由审计手册》进程来说仍然是可行的。 这五张AI生成的图像来自四个不同的生成源:Flux.2 Pro,GPT-Image-1.5,双子座3,以及GPT-Image-1,以确保推理评价贯穿现代顶尖建筑. 通过在五个独立运行中向每个模型展示同样的10个图像,该阶段测试了每个模型是否为相同的输入提供了一致的推理;跨运行中前后不一致的理由会突出检测中的不准确性,而不是真正的结构分析. 由于MLLMs以结构化的JSON格式输出其推理,脚本允许进行分析,以检查模型的文本输出中是否引用了可见或看不见的水印信号.

blocks.en:
To conclude the single-image analysis experiment, the final phase involved a Manual Justification Audit of the natural-language justifications produced in Phase B. Since MLLMs are known to ‘hallucinate’ plausible but factually incorrect justifications ( Ji et al., 2025 ; Bang et al., 2023 ) , the outputs from Phase B were manually audited to evaluate whether the reasoning provided was accurate.
Raw justifications were cross-referenced against a manual visual audit. The MLLM responses were categorised as ‘Correct + Reasonable’ if they referenced correct cues, or ‘Hallucination’ if the classification was correct but supported by non-existent or incorrect artefacts. Manually validating the justifications ensured the study’s conclusions reflected genuine forensic evaluations by the MLLM rather than a statistical guess.
blocks.zh:
为了完成单一图像分析试验,最后阶段对B阶段的自然语言理由进行了人工说明性审计。 由于MLLMs已知 " 冒用 " 合理但事实上不正确的理由(Ji等人,2025年;Bang等人,2023年),对B阶段的产出进行了人工审计,以评估所提供的理由是否准确。
原始理由与人工直观审计相互参照。 MLLM的答复如果引用了正确的提示,则归类为 " 更正+合理 " ;如果分类正确,但有不存在或错误的手工业品支持,则归类为 " Hallucination " 。 人工核实这些理由可以确保研究报告的结论反映劳动和劳工部的真正法证评估,而不是统计猜测。

blocks.en: 3.2.2. Experiment 2: Pairwise Image Analysis (Contextual Advantage)
blocks.zh: 3.2.2. 实验2:对等图像分析(文字优势)

blocks.en: The second experiment introduced contextual reasoning through a TAFC evaluation protocol ( Green and Swets, 1966 ) . To ensure the results were not affected by positional bias, the placement of the authentic and synthetic images as either “Image A” or “Image B” was fully randomised.
blocks.zh: 第二次实验通过TAFC评价协议引入了背景推理(Green and Swets, 1966.). 为确保结果不受位置偏差的影响,将真实的和合成的图像作为“图像A”或“图像B”完全随机放置。

blocks.en: In this part of the experiment, the MLLMs were provided with two randomly selected images, one real image from the FFHQ control dataset and one synthetic image generated by one of the 7 generators at random from the 7 pools of 50 images. The models were prompted with “You are presented with two images, labelled IMAGE A and IMAGE B. One is a REAL photograph, and the other is AI-GENERATED. Your task is to identify which image is the AI-generated fake”, in order to identify which of the two images was AI-generated and which was a real photograph, providing a binary classification and a justification for their decision.
blocks.zh: 在这部分实验中,MLLMs得到了两个随机选择的图像,一个来自FFHQ控制数据集的真实图像,以及一个由7个发电机之一从50个图像的7个集合中随机生成的合成图像. 这些模型的灵感来自“你得到两个图像,分别标注为IMAGE A和IMAGE B。 一个是真实照片,另一个是AI-GENERTED. 你的任务是确定哪些图像是人工智能生成的假象”,以便确定这两个图像中哪一个是人工智能生成的,哪个是真实的照片,提供了二进制的分类和决定的理由。

blocks.en: This methodology, which focuses on the comparison was directly designed to test the Contextual Advantage Hypothesis (H2). The experiment measured whether accuracy improved when models were provided with a real reference image alongside the synthetic one, testing whether comparative context benefits detection performance. Justification analysis was not conducted for Experiment 2, as reasoning auditing was limited to Phase B and C of Experiment 1.
blocks.zh: 这种方法侧重于比较,直接是为了检验背景优势假设(H2)。 实验测量了在向模型提供与合成模型并列的真正参考图像时,是否提高了精度,测试了比较上下文是否有利于检测性能. 没有为实验2进行理由分析,因为推理审计仅限于实验1的B阶段和C阶段。

blocks.en: 3.2.3. Experiment 3: Targeted Watermark Ablation Study (Gemini/SynthID)
blocks.zh: 3.2.3. 实验3:定点水标沉淀研究(Gemini/SynthID)

blocks.en: By introducing an ablation approach, cropping visible watermarks and resampling invisible ones through pixel resampling, this experiment investigates the true detection capabilities of MLLMs. The objective is to determine whether these models genuinely recognise deepfake artefacts, or if their accuracy is influenced by generator traces; a methodology that aligns with the framework established by Gandhi and Jain ( Gandhi and Jain, 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 通过引入膨胀法,裁剪可见水印,并通过像素再取样重新复制可见水印,这一实验调查了MLLMs的真实检测能力. 目的是确定这些模型是否真正识别了深假艺术品,或者其准确性是否受到生成器痕迹的影响;这种方法与甘地和Jain(Gandhi和Jain,2020年)建立的框架相一致。

blocks.en:
The five-dataset comparison framework within this study isolates each signal: visible logo, invisible SynthID, and their combination, to determine whether MLLM accuracy reflects genuine forensic reasoning or watermark exploitation.
This decision to perform an ablation study on the Gemini ecosystem was driven by the integration of SynthID, Google DeepMind’s invisible Watermarking tool. According to official documentation, SynthID “embeds a digital watermark directly into the pixels of an image, making it imperceptible to the human eye, but detectable for identification” ( Google DeepMind, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
本研究中的五数据集比较框架将每个信号:可见的标志,看不见的合成ID及其组合,以确定MLLM精度是否反映真实的法证推理或水印开发.
这个对双子座生态系统进行消融研究的决定,是由Google DeepMind的隐形水印工具SynthID的整合推动的. 根据官方文献,SynthID“将一个数字水印直接嵌入图像的像素中,使其无法被人眼所察觉,但可被识别”(Google DeepMind,2023年)。

blocks.en: Preliminary research for this study revealed a double layer forensic system within Gemini: images generated via the Gemini Web Interface not only include the invisible SynthID embedded watermark but also a visible watermark on the lower right hand corner of the generated image, a small, four-pointed “sparkle” icon. Images sourced directly from the Gemini API (Imagen 3) do not generate the visible logo yet only with SynthID embedded within the image. This provided an opportunity to study the importance of each marker in a controlled environment, forming the basis for the five-dataset ablation structure.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的初步研究揭示了双子座内部的双层法证系统:通过双子座网络界面生成的图像不仅包括隐形合成器嵌入水印,还包括生成图像右下角的可见水印,一个小的,四点的"sparkle"图标. 直接来自双子座API(Imagen 3)的图像,并没有生成可见的标志,但仅使用嵌入在图像中的SynthID. 这为研究每个标记在受控制环境中的重要性提供了机会,构成五数据集衰减结构的基础。

blocks.en: To investigate this, five distinct datasets (Pools) were constructed: • D1 (Gemini-API): Raw Gemini API output (Imagen 3) — SynthID only, no logo. These images form the Gemini generator pool used in Experiments 1 and 2. • D2 (Gemini-Web): Raw Gemini Web Interface output — SynthID + visible sparkle logo. • D3 (Gemini-Web-Cropped): D2 with visible logo manually cropped. • D4 (Gemini-Web-Ablated): D2 subjected to LDM reconstruction — logo remains, SynthID disrupted. • D5 (Gemini-Full-Ablation): D2 cropped and subjected to LDM reconstruction — no logo, SynthID disrupted.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这一点,构建了五个不同的数据集(Pools): • D1 (Gemini-API): Raw 双子座API输出(Imagen 3)——仅合成ID,没有标志. 这些图像形成了实验1号和2号所使用的双子座发电机池. • D2(Gemini-Web):原始双子座 Web 界面输出——合成ID+可见的闪光标志. ^ D3(Gemini-Web-cropped): 手动裁剪带有可见标志的D2. • D4(Gemini-Web-Ablated):D2 需经过LDM重建——标志遗存,合成ID中断. • D5(Gemini-Full-Abblation):D2被裁剪并受到LDM重建——没有标志,SynthID中断.

blocks.en: To complete the ablation experiment, the neutralisation of the SynthID signal in Datasets 4 and 5 was essential. This was achieved through an Image-to-Image (img2img) LDM reconstruction pass utilising the Hugging Face Diffusers library ( von Platen et al., 2022 ) . Specifically, the pipeline employed the Realistic Vision V5.1 model ( Davì, 2023 ) , which was selected for its ability to maintain high photographic quality during pixel resynthesis.
blocks.zh: 为了完成衰减实验,必须使数据集4和数据集5中的合成ID信号中和. 这是通过使用Hugging Face Diffuses图书馆(von Platen et al., 2022)的图像到图像(img2img)LDM重建通道实现的。 具体来说,管道采用了Realistic Vision V5.1模型(Davì, 2023年),因其在像素合成期间保持高摄影质量的能力而被选中.

blocks.en:
By altering the pixels at a tested 0.15 strength, a value supported by Zhao et al. ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) for diffusion-based image alterations, the high-frequency digital watermarks were successfully disrupted while still maintaining high visual quality of the image’s original state. This specific strength was selected to minimise degradation of the subject’s facial biometrics and keeping the image metadata such as the background and lighting as similar as possible to the originally generated image.
This could be a tactic a malicious actor might use to bypass AI detection by running an image through a secondary generative pass. The complete watermark removal script is provided in the corpus at 04_Experiment_3_Watermark_Ablation/remove_synthid_dataset4.py .
blocks.zh:
通过在测试的0.15强度下改变像素,这个数值得到了赵等人的支持. (Zhao et al., 2023年)用于基于扩散的图像改造,高频数字水印被成功中断,同时仍然保持了图像原始状态的高视觉质量. 选择这种具体力量是为了最大限度地减少被试者面部生物特征的退化,并尽可能保持图像元数据,如背景和照明与最初生成的图像相似.
这可能是恶意行为者通过二次基因传球运行图像来绕过AI检测的战术. 完整的水印去除脚本见于本体04_Experiment_3_Watermark_Ablation/remove_synthid_dataset4.py.

blocks.en: To evaluate the impact of specific forensic markers (H3), five distinct dataset comparisons were conducted. This matrix isolates the presence of invisible SynthID signals against visible “sparkle” watermarks to determine their individual and combined effects on detection accuracy. The raw dataset comparison results are archived within the corpus at 04_Experiment_3_Watermark_Ablation/Dataset_Comparison_Results/ .

blocks.en:
Temperature settings were applied differently across generators and detectors. For image generation, a temperature of 0.0 was set where the API permitted within an adjustable parameter to produce deterministic outputs. For the six MLLM detectors, models were kept at their default settings (typically 1.0) to represent realistic conditions. The temperature differences between models were a deliberate choice to allow detectors to operate under their standard conditions. Not all MLLM APIs expose a temperature parameter; where this setting was unavailable, the model’s default configuration was used. Gemini’s detection configuration was explicitly set to 0.0 to ensure consistent justification outputs across the five repeated runs in Phase B of Experiment 1.
Instructions and system prompts remained uniform across all platforms to prevent any potential prompt bias.
blocks.zh:
不同发电机和探测器的温度设置不同。 对于图像生成,设定温度为0.0,其中API允许在可调整参数内产生确定性输出. 对于6个MLLM探测器,模型被保存在其默认设置(通常为1.0),以代表现实的条件. 模型之间的温度差异是允许探测器在标准条件下运行的蓄意选择。 并非所有的 MLLM API 都会暴露一个温度参数;如果无法使用此设置,则会使用模型的默认配置 。 双子座的探测配置被明确设定为0.0,以确保在实验1的B阶段的五次重复运行中,始终如一地说明理由。
所有平台的指令和系统提示仍然一致,以防止任何潜在的即时偏见。

blocks.en: The independent variables across the three experiments were:

• Detector Model: The six MLLMs under evaluation, including GPT-5.2, GPT-5, GPT-4o, Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, and Seed 1.6. • Generator Source: the generator source of the evaluated image (the seven generators plus FFHQ authentic images) • Experimental Condition: the experimental condition: single-image, pairwise, or ablation dataset tier (D1–D5). The dependent variable in all three experiments was binary classification accuracy: 1 for a correct classification and 0 for an incorrect one.

blocks.en: 4. Results
blocks.zh: 4个 结果

blocks.en: 4.1. Overview of Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4.1. 实验结果概述

blocks.en: Section 3 described image generators as Large Vision Models (LVMs) while the six MLLM detectors: GPT-5.2, GPT-5, GPT-4o, Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5 and Seed 1.6 represent a separate set of models. During the time of evaluation, GPT-4o and Seed 1.6 were included as detectors because they represent the most accessible commercial MLLMs from their ecosystems. This enabled cross-generation comparison within the GPT family and cross-ecosystem comparison with ByteDance’s Seed platform.
blocks.zh: 第3节将图像生成器描述为大视野模型(LVM),而6个MLLM探测器:GPT-5.2,GPT-5,GPT-4o,双子座3,双子座2.5和种子1.6分别代表了一组模型. 在评估期间,GPT-4o和种子1.6被列为探测器,因为它们代表着来自其生态系统的最易获取的商业MLLMs. 这使得GPT家族内部的跨世代比较和跨生态系统比较能够与ByteDance的种子平台比较.

blocks.en: Table 1 provides a cross-experiment overview of pairwise versus single-image accuracy shifts across all six detectors, directly relevant to H2 (Pairwise Image Advantage). Figure 4 visualises the single-image versus pairwise accuracy gap across all six detectors.
blocks.zh: 表1提供了所有6个探测器的对偶与单图像精度变化的交叉实验概况,直接与H2(对偶图像优势)相关. 图4可视化了所有6个探测器的单映像与对映精度差距.

blocks.en: Table 1 . Summary of detector model performance across single-image and pairwise conditions. Models are ranked in descending order according to their mean single-image accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表1. 按区域分列的 单像和对偶条件的探测器模型性能概要. 模型按其平均单像精度的降序排列.

blocks.en: Figure 4 . Comparative performance of detector models. Results are ranked by baseline single-image mean from best to worst. Note the performance gains in the GPT family compared to the accuracy decline observed in the Gemini ecosystem under pairwise conditions.
blocks.zh: 图4 探测器模型的比较性能. 成果按基准单像平均值从最佳到最差排序。 注意与双子体生态系统在双子体条件下观察到的精度下降相比,GPT家族的性能提高.

blocks.en: 4.2. Experiment 1 Results: Single-Image Baseline and Qualitative Reasoning
blocks.zh: 4.2. 实验1结果: 单一图像基线和定性理由

blocks.en: 4.2.1. Quantitative Zero-Shot Baseline
blocks.zh: 4.2.1. 定量零热基线

blocks.en:
Tier 1’s primary objective was to determine whether MLLMs are capable of identifying AI-generated images without any external references. The performance matrix within Table 2 highlights that some models demonstrated clear forensic capability; the remaining models struggled to exceed even the 50% baseline for this study.
Based on the single-image analysis results, the most effective detector was GPT-5.2 achieving a mean accuracy of 78.8%. GPT-5 and Gemini 3 also performed well with levels above 60% (full data within the corpus 02_Experiment_1_Single_Image/single_image_analysis_phaseA.xlsx ).
blocks.zh:
第一级的主要目标是确定MLLMs是否能够在没有任何外部参考的情况下识别AI生成的图像。 表2中的性能矩阵突出表明,一些模型显示出明显的法证能力;其余模型甚至努力超过了本研究的50%基线。
根据单像分析结果,最有效的探测器是GPT-5.2,达到78.8%的平均精度. GPT-5和双子座3也表现良好,水平超过60%(完整数据存在于02_Experiment_1_Single_Image/sing_image_analysis_phaseA.xlsx)。

blocks.en: Table 2 . Single-image detection accuracy (%) per detector model per generator source. Models are grouped by vendor ecosystem. Shaded cells indicate same-ecosystem detector-generator pairs (self-detection), relevant to H1.
blocks.zh: 表2. 每个发电机源的单个图像检测精度(%)。 模式按供应商生态系统分类。 阴影细胞表示同电子系统探测器-生成器对(自测),与H1相关.

blocks.en:
However, the results revealed a significant performance gap with both Seed 1.6 (56.8%) and GPT-4o (58.3%) hovering just above the 50% baseline used. These models often failed to identify structural artefacts within the images, suggesting that their detection capabilities are not precise enough to be used within a forensic setting. In addition the Standard Deviation (SD) for Seed 1.6 (6.70) was the highest figure amongst the models. This indicated that not only was the model’s performance low but also inconsistent compared to the other models tested across the ten experimental runs. Therefore, while H1 is supported for the more advanced architectures, detection capability is not consistent across the current MLLMs.
The results further revealed that detection accuracy was significantly influenced by the generator source of the AI-generated image. As shown in Table 2 , the detection rates varied considerably depending on which of the seven generators produced the image that was being evaluated. These results suggest that generator architecture has influence on how detectable the image is.
blocks.zh:
然而,结果显示,种子1.6(56.8%)和GPT-4o(58.3%)的性能差距很大,它们都徘徊在50%的基准线上。 这些模型往往未能在图像中识别出结构文物,表明其探测能力不够精确,无法在法医环境中使用。 此外,种子1.6的标准开发(SD)是模型中最高的数字。 这表明,该模型的性能不仅低,而且与在10次试验中测试的其他模型相比也不一致。 因此,虽然H1支持更先进的架构,但目前MLLMs的检测能力并不一致.
结果进一步揭示,检测精度受到AI生成图像的生成源的重大影响. 如表2所示,探测率因七台发电机中哪台产生正在评价的图像而有很大差异。 这些结果表明,生成器架构对图像的可探测性有影响.

blocks.en:
With a cross-model mean detection rate of 80.6%, Flux.2 Pro was the most easily identifiable generator. The results imply that Flux.2 Pro likely produces more detectable artefacts.
In contrast, Gemini 3 generated images were the most difficult to detect by the six detectors within the study, with a mean detection rate of just 50.4%, at the boundary of random chance and therefore indicating that the most recent generative architectures are reaching a point where standalone zero-shot single-image classification is becoming an unreliable forensic methodology.
blocks.zh:
跨型号平均检测率为80.6%,Flux。 Pro是最容易识别的发电机。 结果意味着奢侈。 很可能生产出更多的可探测文物。
相比之下,双子座3生成的图像是最难被研究范围内的6个探测器发现的,平均探测率只有50.4%,在随机机会的边界上,因此表明最近的基因结构正在达到一个孤立的零镜头单像分类正在成为不可靠的法证方法的地步.

blocks.en: A Mann-Whitney U test comparing self-model detection accuracy (same-ecosystem detector-generator pairs) against cross-model accuracy revealed p = 0.384 p=0.384 , r = 0.188 r=0.188 , confirming that ecosystem alignment was not a statistically significant predictor of detection accuracy.
blocks.zh: 曼・怀特尼 U测试将自建模检测精度(同型-生态系统检测器-生成器对)与跨模型检测精度进行比较,发现p=0.384 p=0.384,r=0.188 r=0.188,证实生态系统校正不是统计上重要的检测精度预测器.

blocks.en: The diagonal effect, where same-ecosystem detector-generator pairs show varying performance, is visible in the highlighted cells of Table 2 and is discussed in the H1 verdict.
blocks.zh: 对角效应,即同电子系统探测器-生成器对子显示不同性能,可见于表2的突出显示的单元格中,并在H1判决中讨论.

blocks.en: 4.2.2. Qualitative Reasoning
blocks.zh: 4.2.2. 定性理由

blocks.en: Phase B investigated the forensic reasoning provided by each model through an evaluation focused on a subset of ten images, each analysed across five separate iterations. Using a Manual Justification Audit, justifications were sorted into specific categories: “Correct + Reasonable” were assigned when a model identified authentic structural indicators, while “Incorrect Detection” was used for failed classifications. The compiled results are presented in Table 3 ; the complete audit spreadsheet is provided in the corpus at 02_Experiment_1_Single_Image/Manual_audit.xlsx .
blocks.zh: B阶段调查了每个模型提供的法证推理,评价侧重于10个图像的子集,每个集对五个不同的迭代进行了分析。 使用《说明理由审计手册》,将理由归为具体类别:“更正+合理”,当一个模型确定真实的结构指标时,即予分配,而“不正确的检测”则用于失败的分类。 汇总结果见表3;完整的审计电子表格载于02_Experiment_1_Single_Image/Manual_audit.xlsx。

blocks.en: Table 3 . Phase B Manual Justification Audit results: frequency of correct and reasonable justifications across 48 evaluated cases per model (10 fixed images × 5 runs = 50 classification events per model; 2 cases excluded due to Gemini 3’s content safety block on one authentic image, yielding 48 usable responses) Models are presented in a fixed order consistent with baseline performance rankings.
blocks.zh: 表 3 国家 B阶段手册 理由说明 审计结果:每个模型评价的48个案件(10个固定图像×5运行=每个模型的50个分类事件;由于双子座3的内容安全屏蔽在一个真实图像上,排除了2个案件,得出48个可用答复) 模型按照与基线性能排名一致的固定顺序列报.

blocks.en:
Leading the qualitative evaluation with 93.8% was GPT-5.2, citing structural artefacts correctly such as unusual object geometry, unnatural image texture and blurred image backgrounds. GPT-4o had a considerably weaker score of 58.3% despite sharing the same architectural lineage as GPT-5 and GPT-5.2. This suggests that model version, rather than the generator ecosystem, is the strongest factor of forensic reasoning quality. Gemini 3 triggered a content safety block on one authentic FFHQ image, returning no classification and therefore recording it as an automatic detection failure. The Manual Justification Audit revealed that no hallucinations occurred in any of the models and that every error recorded was simply a misclassification rather than a correct guess.
Sun et al. ( Sun et al., 2025 ) and Li et al. ( Li et al., 2025a ) predicted hallucinations would be common; however, no hallucinations were recorded. Every misclassification was accompanied by structurally coherent reasoning, the models were wrong, but their logic was reasonable due to image inconsistencies. A clear illustration of this is img_0017.png ,as shown below within Figure 5 , a GPT-Image-1.5 generated image with four out of six detector models classified as real across all five runs. Only Gemini 3 and GPT-5.2 correctly identified it as an AI-generated image by observing inconsistent hair blurring and implausible background geometry.
blocks.zh:
以93.8%的定性评价率领先的是GPT-5.2,引用的结构文物正确,如不寻常的物体几何、不自然的图像纹理和模糊的图像背景。 尽管与GPT-5和GPT-5.2的建筑系相同,但GPT-4o的得分却低得多,为58.3%。 这表明模型版本而非生成生态系统是法证推理质量的最强因素. 双子座3在一台真实的FFHQ图像上触发了内容安全块,不返回分类,因此将其记录为自动检测失败. 《说明理由审计手册》显示,在任何模型中都没有出现幻觉,记录的每一个错误只是错误的分类,而不是正确的猜测。
孙等. (Sun等人,2025年)和Li等人著. (Li等人,2025a)预测的幻觉是常见的;然而,没有记录到幻觉. 每次错误的分类都伴随着结构连贯的推理,模型是错误的,但由于图像不一致,它们的逻辑是合理的. 如下图5所示,一个GPT-Image-1.5生成的图像中,有6个探测器模型中有4个被归类为在所有5个运行中真实的。 只有双子座3和GPT-5.2通过观察前后不一的头发模糊和不可信的背景几何来正确识别为AI生成的图像.

blocks.en: Figure 5 . img_0017.png, GPT-Image-1.5 generated image with four out of six detector models classified as real across all five runs.
blocks.zh: 图5 . img_0017.png,GPT-Image-1.5生成图像,在全部5个运行中,6个探测器模型中有4个被归类为真实.

blocks.en: 4.2.3. Hypothesis Verdicts: H1 and H4
blocks.zh: 4.2.3. 假设判断:H1和H4

blocks.en: Tier 1 experiment results offer only partial support for Hypothesis 1 (H1), this is seen in GPT-5.2 detecting GPT-Image-1 with 84.3% detection accuracy and Gemini 2.5 detecting Gemini AI-generated images at 79.9% detection accuracy. Neither figure supports a consistent advantage over performance against external generator models. For example, GPT-5.2 achieved 87.9% detection against Flux.2 Pro generated images, a completely different generation ecosystem. It is possible that the quality and artefacts of the generated image appear to be the strongest factors of detection difficulty than specific ecosystem alignment between the detector and the generator (see Appendix A.2.1 for full test output).
blocks.zh: 第一级实验结果仅部分支持假想1(H1),这在GPT-5.2检测GPT-Image-1中可见,检测精度为84.3%,双子座2.5检测双子座AI生成的图像为79.9%检测精度. 两者都支持相对于外部生成器模型的一贯优势。 例如,GPT-5.2对流量进行了87.9%的检测。 Pro生成的图像,一个完全不同的一代生态系统. 与探测器与生成器之间的特定生态系统对接相比,生成的图像的质量和手工艺品似乎是检测难度最大的因素(全面测试输出见附录A.2.1)。

blocks.en: H4 is partially rejected as no hallucinations were recorded across any model, suggesting these models engage in genuine forensic reasoning rather than the shortcut-driven pattern predicted by recent literature.
blocks.zh: H4被部分拒绝,因为没有记录任何模型的幻觉,这表明这些模型进行真正的法证推理,而不是最近文献预测的捷径驱动模式.

blocks.en: The Manual Justification Audit was conducted by a single researcher, which introduces a confirmation bias risk. A future approach should involve multiple auditors to cross-verify the AI’s reasoning patterns to ensure the no-hallucination finding is not a product of one opinion.
blocks.zh: 手册说明 审计由一位研究人员进行,这带来了确认偏向的风险。 今后的做法应当包括多个审计员交叉核查大赦国际的推理模式,以确保不吸血结论不是一种意见的产物。

blocks.en: Hypothesis Verdicts: H1 and H4 H1 (Self-Detection): Partially Supported — GPT-5.2 and Gemini 2.5 showed modest same-ecosystem advantages, but generator image quality proved a far stronger predictor of detection difficulty than ecosystem alignment. H4 (Justification Reliability): Partially Rejected — No hallucinations were recorded across any model; all errors were clean misclassifications, suggesting genuine forensic reasoning rather than shortcut-driven pattern matching.
blocks.zh: 伪证:H1和H4 H1(自测): 部分支持——GPT-5.2和双子座2.5表现出适度的同生态系统优势,但发电机图像质量被证明是比生态系统对齐更强的检测难度预测器. H4(合理可靠性): 部分拒绝 - 没有记录任何模型的幻觉;所有错误都是干净的错分类,表明真实的法证推理而非快捷模式驱动的匹配.

blocks.en: 4.3. Experiment 2 Results: Pairwise Classification and Contextual Advantage
blocks.zh: 4.3. 实验2结果:对等分类和背景优势

blocks.en: The primary objective of tier 2 was to determine whether the presence of a real image during the evaluation would improve detection accuracy across the six detector models. Table 4 presents the full pairwise experiment detection matrix across all detector and generator combinations.
blocks.zh: 第2级的主要目标是确定在评价期间是否存在真实图像是否有助于提高6个探测器模型的探测准确性。 表4列出了所有探测器和发电机组合的全双向实验检测矩阵。

blocks.en: Table 4 . Pairwise detection accuracy (%) per detector model per generator source. Performance change compared to Table 2’s single-image baseline is shown in parentheses. Models are grouped by vendor ecosystem.
blocks.zh: 表4 每一个发电机源的每个探测器模型的对等检测精度(%)。 与表2的单一图像基线相比,性能变化列于括号内。 模式按供应商生态系统分类。

blocks.en: GPT-5.2 achieved the strongest pairwise performance with a mean accuracy of 82.5%, reaching a peak of 97.9% against Flux.2 Pro generated images, the highest single detection rate recorded across the entire study. All GPT models improved under pairwise conditions with GPT-5 gaining 4.9 percentage points and GPT-4o gaining 3.0 points compared to their single-image baselines. All three GPT models gained accuracy within the pairwise experiment, suggesting that a detector benefits from a comparative reference rather than being confused by it.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.2实现了最强的对偶性能,平均精度达到82.5%,对流达到97.9%的峰值。 Pro生成的图像,是整个研究中记录的最高单检率. 所有GPT模型在对称条件下都有改进,GPT-5比其单像基线增加4.9个百分点,GPT-4o比其单像基线增加3.0个百分点. 所有三种GPT模型在对称实验中都获得了准确性,这表明探测器从比较参考中受益,而不是被其混淆.

blocks.en: Wilcoxon Signed-Rank tests comparing each detector’s pairwise accuracy against its single-image baseline did not confirm a statistically significant improvement for GPT-5.2 (p = 0.406, r = 0.393) despite its descriptive gains, but did confirm a highly significant decline for Gemini 2.5 (p = 0.016, r = -1.000, see Appendix A.2.2 for full test results).
blocks.zh: Wilcoxon 署名-Rank测试将每个探测器的双向精度与其单像基线相比较,但并未证实GPT-5.2(p = 0.406,r = 0.393)在统计学上有显著的改进,但证实双子座2.5(p = 0.016,r = -1.000,全面测试结果见附录A.2.2)。

blocks.en: 4.3.1. Unexpected Pairwise Behaviour in Gemini Models
blocks.zh: 4.3.1. 双子座模型中的不预期对等行为

blocks.en: An important realisation within the Tier 2 experiment was that Gemini models recorded lower accuracy, not higher, under pairwise conditions. Gemini 2.5 recorded the steepest drop of any model in the study, falling 17.1 percentage points from 62.6% to 45.5%, below the random chance threshold of 50%. Gemini 3 similarly declined by 5.0 points to 64.5%. This pattern contradicts H2 for the Gemini ecosystem and was an unexpected finding of the study.
blocks.zh: 第二级试验的一个重要成就是双子座模型在双子座条件下记录的精度较低,而不是更高。 双子座2.5在研究中记录了任何模型最大幅度的下降,从62.6%下降到45.5%,低于50%的随机机会阈值. 双子座3同样下降了5.0个百分点,达到64.5%. 这种模式与双子座生态系统的H2相矛盾,是研究的意外发现.

blocks.en: One explanation for this behaviour is “comparison noise” which is when the introduction of a real image appears to interfere with Gemini’s classification process rather than assist detection by providing a comparative reference point. Gemini models may be exhibiting a comparative bias that causes them to doubt the structural cues they previously detected in the single-image analysis. This is most evident in Gemini 2.5’s performance against Gemini 3 generated images, which declined to just 21.3% within the pairwise analysis compared to 40.3% in the single-image analysis, significantly below the random chance percentage and suggesting misclassification rather than simple uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 对这种行为的一个解释是 " 比较噪音 " ,即引入真实图像似乎干扰双子座的分类过程,而不是通过提供比较参考点来协助检测。 双子座模型可能表现出比较偏差,导致它们怀疑之前在单像分析中检测到的结构提示. 这在双子座2.5对双子座3生成的图像的性能中最为明显,双子座3在双子座分析中下降到21.3%,而在单像分析中则下降到40.3%,大大低于随机机率,暗示了错误的分类而不是简单的不确定性。

blocks.en: However, “comparison noise” remains a suggested explanation rather than a confirmed justification. Another possibility would be that Gemini’s training might use different logic when comparing images side-by-side than when judging a single image alone. This could be tested by pairing two synthetic images together rather than one real and one fake as an extension of experiment 2.
blocks.zh: 然而,“比较噪音”仍然是建议的解释,而不是得到确认的理由。 另一种可能性是,双子座的训练在边对图像进行比较时可能采用不同的逻辑,而不是单独判断一个图像时。 这可以通过将两个合成图像组合在一起进行测试,而不是将一个真实的和一个假的图像组合在一起,作为实验2的延伸.

blocks.en: 4.3.2. Generator Difficulty Under Pairwise Conditions
blocks.zh: 4.3.2. 对等条件下的发电机难度

blocks.en: The patterns observed within Tier 1 continued to persist under pairwise analysis. Gemini 3 images remained the most difficult to detect with a cross-model mean of 43.6%, while Flux.2 Pro remained the most detectable generator at 83.6%. However, a shift was observed as Gemini 2.5 images became the easiest to detect under the pairwise-image experiment with a mean of 85.7%, overtaking Flux.2 Pro.
blocks.zh: 在第一级观测到的形态在双向分析下继续存在。 双子座3的图像仍然是最难发现的,跨型平均43.6%,而Flux2 Pro仍然是最可探测的发电机,为83.6%. 然而,由于双子座2.5图像在对映实验下以85.7%的平均值成为最容易检测的,超过了Flux2 Pro,因此观察到了一次转变.

blocks.en: 4.3.3. Hypothesis Verdict: H2

Overall, the pairwise-image results provide partial support for Hypothesis 2 (H2). The GPT-series showed consistent descriptive advantage, though these did not reach statistical significance. Through the unexpected findings regarding the Gemini family, H2 is rejected for the Gemini family, where pairwise presentation was associated with a significant decline in performance.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,对映结果为假说2(H2)提供了部分支持. 全球统计方案系列显示出前后一致的描述优势,尽管这些优势并不具有统计意义。 通过对双子座家族的意想不到的发现,H2被双子座家族拒绝,双子座的呈现与性能显著下降有关.

blocks.en: Hypothesis Verdict: H2 H2 (Contextual Advantage): Partially Supported — The GPT family showed consistent descriptive gains (+3.0 to +4.9pp) that were not statistically significant, but Gemini 2.5 showed a statistically significant decline ( p = 0.016 p=0.016 , r = − 1.000 r=-1.000 ).
blocks.zh: 假设判断:H2 H2(文字优势):部分支持——GPT家族表现出一致的描述收益(+3.0至+4.9pp),这些收益在统计学上没有意义,但双子座2.5显示出统计学上的显著下降(p=0.016 p=0.016,r=-1 000 r=-1.000).

blocks.en: 4.4. Experiment 3 Results: Watermark Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4. 实验3结果:水印沉积研究

blocks.en: 4.4.1. Ablation Study Overview
blocks.zh: 4.4.1. 研究概况

blocks.en: The third experiment within this study investigates how Gemini’s detection accuracy either increases or decreases with the presence of digital watermarking (SynthID) embedded within its own generated images. Five image datasets were constructed to test the effect of the two Gemini watermarks present within their images: the visible sparkle logo present on web-generated Gemini images, and the invisible SynthID signal embedded within the image’s pixels. Five comparisons were conducted across these datasets using Wilcoxon Signed-Rank tests for paired comparisons and a Mann-Whitney U test for the independent stability check, with effect sizes reported as Rank-Biserial Correlation (r). Table 5 presents the detection rates and statistical results across all comparisons. The complete Wilcoxon output for all ablation comparisons is provided in Appendix A.3. Figure 6 also provides a visual representation of the detection accuracy across tiers D1–D5 as described above.
blocks.zh: 本研究中的第三项实验调查了双子座的探测精度如何随着嵌入于自己生成的图像中的数码水印(SynthID)而增减. 构建了五个图像数据集,以测试其图像中存在的两个双子星水印的效果:网络生成的双子星图像上的可见闪光标志,以及图像像素中嵌入的无形合成ID信号. 对这些数据集进行了5次比较,使用Wilcoxon Sign-Rank测试进行配对比较,使用Mann-Whitney U测试进行独立稳定性检查,效果大小报告为Rank-Biserial Correlation(r)。 表5列出所有比较的检测率和统计结果。 附录A.3提供了全部Wilcoxon产出,用于进行所有比对。 图6还显示上述D1-D5级的探测精度。
