blocks.en: 4.4.2. Stability and Baseline (C1)
blocks.zh: 4.4.2. 稳定性和基线(C1)

blocks.en: Comparison C1 compared D1 (Gemini-API) against D3 (Gemini-Web-Cropped), returning p = 0.4354 p=0.4354 with a negligible effect size of r = 0.078 r=0.078 . This suggests no significant difference between dataset groups, validating that subsequent comparisons reflect watermark manipulation rather than image content variability.
blocks.zh: 比较C1比较D1(Gemini-API)与D3(Gemini-Web-Cropped),返回p=0.4354p=0.4354,可忽略不计的效果大小为r=0.078r=0.078. 这表明数据集组之间没有显著的区别,证明随后的比较反映了水印的操纵而不是图像内容的可变性.

blocks.en: 4.4.3. Visible Watermark Effect (C2)
blocks.zh: 4.4.3. 可见水印效应(C2)

blocks.en: Comparison C2 explored the impact of the sparkle logo within Gemini generated images by comparing D2 (Gemini-Web), whose images contained both the visible logo and SynthID against D3 (Gemini-Web-Cropped), containing SynthID only with the visible logo cropped. The Wilcoxon Signed-Rank test returned p = 0.0075 p=0.0075 with a medium effect size of r = 0.378 r=0.378 , showing that the visible logo has a meaningful impact on detection consistency. Upon removal of the visible logo, detection dropped from 100% to 90%, indicating that the sparkle icon can be identified as a forensic shortcut that significantly improves accuracy when present. This indicates that removing a visible watermark leads to lower detection reliability.
blocks.zh: 比较C2通过比较D2(Gemini-Web)来探讨闪光标志在双子公司生成的图像内的影响,其图像既包含可见的标志,也包含SynthID与D3(Gemini-Web-Cropped),只包含SynthID与被裁剪的可见的标志. Wilcoxon签名-Rank测试返回p = 0.0075 p = 0.0075,中等效果大小为r = 0.378 r = 0.378,显示可见的标志对检测一致性有有意义的影响. 在移除可见标志后,检测率从100%降至90%,表明闪光图标可以被识别为法证快捷方式,当存在时可显著提高准确性. 这表明移除一个可见的水印会导致检测可靠性降低.

blocks.en: 4.4.4. SynthID as a Secondary Signal (C4)
blocks.zh: 4.4.4. 合成ID作为二级信号(C4)

blocks.en: Comparison C4 examined D2 (Gemini-Web) whose images contained both watermarks, visible and invisible, against D4 (Gemini-Web-Ablated) where SynthID had been neutralised but the visible logo remained. The Wilcoxon test returned p = 0.0455 p=0.0455 with a small effect size of r = 0.283 r=0.283 and both datasets remained at 100% binary detection for its Gemini AI-generated images. The difference in detection probability scores suggests that SynthID provides a second layer of forensic data even when the visible watermark is already present. This minor difference in effect size indicates the visible logo provides the primary forensic evidence, which restricts the additional impact SynthID can provide. Even so, its role remains statistically significant and should be recognised as more than just a redundant feature.
blocks.zh: 比较C4检查了D2(Gemini-Web),其图像既包含可见和看不见的水印,又与SynthID中和但可见的标志仍然存在的D4(Gemini-Web-Ablated)相对. Wilcoxon测试返回 p = 0.0455 p = 0.0455,其小效果大小为 r = 02.83 r = 0.283,两个数据集对其双子体AI生成的图像仍然保持在100%的二进制检测. 检测概率分数的差异表明,即使可见水印已经存在,合成ID还是提供了第二层法证数据. 这种作用大小的细微差别表明可见的标志提供了主要的法证证据,这限制了合成ID能够提供的额外影响. 即使如此,它的作用在统计学上仍然很重要,应该被承认不仅仅是一个多余的特点。

blocks.en: 4.4.5. The Ceiling Effect (C3)

Comparison C3 compared D4 (Gemini-Web-Ablated) containing the visible sparkle logo but no SynthID, against D5 (Gemini-Full-Ablation) which was the fully ablated pure control containing no watermarks of any kind. The Wilcoxon test returned p = 1.000 p=1.000 with an effect size of r = 0.000 r=0.000 , with both datasets recording 100% detection when asked to detect the AI-generated image. The significance in C3 is Gemini’s ability to detect its own images through structural analysis, not through watermarks. It confirms that even when all watermark signals have been removed, Gemini still achieves perfect detection of its own generated images. This is attributed to Gemini detecting native artefacts by identifying structural inconsistencies within the image without relying on embedded watermarking signals. These results represent the ceiling effect as detection has already reached 100% through structural reasoning; watermarks within the image could not mathematically improve the score further.
blocks.zh: 比较C3比较了D4(Gemini-Web-Ablated)包含可见的闪光标志,但没有合成ID,与D5(Gemini-Full-Ablation)比较,后者是完全消散的纯控制,没有任何水印. Wilcoxon测试返回p = 1.000 p = 1.000,效果大小为 r = 0.000 r = 0.000,两个数据集在被要求检测AI生成的图像时记录100%的检测. C3的意义在于双子座通过结构分析而不是通过水印来探测自己的图像的能力. 它证实,即使所有水印信号都已被移除,双子座仍然能够完美地探测到自己生成的图像. 这归因于双子座通过识别图像内部的结构不一致而不依赖于嵌入式水印信号来检测原生文物. 这些结果代表了天花板效应,因为通过结构推理检测已经达到100%;图像中的水印无法在数学上进一步提高分数.

blocks.en: 4.4.6. Pure SynthID Impact (C5)
blocks.zh: 4.4.6. 纯合成物影响(C5)

blocks.en: Comparison C5 reveals the impact of SynthID which compares D3 (Gemini-Web-Cropped), containing only the invisible SynthID signal with the logo removed, against D5 (Gemini-Full-Ablation), the fully ablated control. The Wilcoxon test returned p = 0.0020 p=0.0020 with a medium-large effect size of r = 0.437 r=0.437 which confirms that SynthID is statistically significant and a powerful forensic signal, the strongest invisible cue for the detector when no other hints are present. However after careful analysis: detection reached only 90% in the SynthID-only group, whereas it hit 100% in the fully ablated control. This contradiction may reflect a masking phenomenon observed during evaluation. The reconstruction method to neutralise SynthID in D5 (Gemini-Full-Ablation) likely amplified native structural artefacts. In contrast, the embedding process for SynthID in D3 (Gemini-Web-Cropped) may have slightly diminished the high-frequency details that aid structural identification. SynthID serves as both a powerful forensic signal and a subtle inhibitor of the native structural artefacts that underpin successful detection.
blocks.zh: 比较C5揭示了SynthID比较D3(Gemini-Web-Croped)的影响,它只包含隐形SynthID信号和去除的标志,与D5(Gemini-Full-Ablation)相对,是完全消退的控制. Wilcoxon测试返回 p = 0.0020 p = 0.0020,中等大效果大小为 r = 0.437 r = 0.437,证实合成ID在统计学上具有显著性,是强大的法证信号,是探测器在没有其他提示时最强的隐形提示. 然而经过仔细分析后:检测到的只有合成ID组的90%,而在完全减速的控制中则达到了100%. 这种矛盾可能反映了评价期间观察到的一种掩盖现象。 在D5(Gemini-Full-Ablation)中中和合成ID的重建方法可能放大原生结构文物. 相比之下,D3(Gemini-Web-Cropped)中合成ID的嵌入过程可能略微降低了帮助结构识别的高频细节. 合成 身份证既是强大的法证信号,也是作为成功探测基础的当地结构文物的微妙抑制剂。

blocks.en: 4.4.7. Hypothesis Verdict: H3

Following the full ablation experiments, the results partially reject hypothesis 3. The Hypothesis predicted that the presence of any watermarks would increase detection accuracy however the data exposes the impact of image watermarking. Visible watermarks do provide a significant detection boost (C2: p = 0.0075 p=0.0075 , r = 0.378 r=0.378 ), and SynthID functions as a strong independent forensic signal in isolation (C5: p = 0.0020 p=0.0020 , r = 0.437 r=0.437 ). However, when all watermarks are removed entirely from the AI-generated images, detection still remains at 100% through native artefact analysis. This implies that watermarks are not essential to MLLM-based forensic detection. In addition the masking phenomenon identified in C5 further reveals that future invisible watermarks should be designed with careful consideration of their potential to suppress the structural signals that MLLM forensic tools depend upon.
blocks.zh: 完全衰减实验后,结果部分否定假设 3. 假设预测,任何水印的存在都会提高检测的准确性,但数据暴露了图像水印的影响。 可见水印确实提供了显著的检测助推(C2:p = 0.0075 p = 0.0075,r = 0.378 r = 0.378),合成器作为隔离中的强独立的法证信号功能(C5:p = 0.0020 p = 0.0020,r = 0.437 r = 0.437),然而,当所有水印全部从AI生成的图像中移除时,通过原生动脉分析,检测仍然保持在100%. 这意味着水印对于基于MLLM的法医检测并不必不可少. 此外,C5中确定的遮掩现象进一步表明,未来的无形水印的设计应认真考虑其抑制MLLM法医学工具所依赖的结构信号的潜力。

blocks.en: Hypothesis Verdict: H3 H3 (Effects of Watermarks): Partially Rejected — Visible watermarks provided a significant boost ( p = 0.0075 p=0.0075 , r = 0.378 r=0.378 ) and SynthID is a strong independent signal ( p = 0.0020 p=0.0020 , r = 0.437 r=0.437 ), but native structural artefact analysis alone achieved 100% detection, suggesting watermarks are supplementary and not essential.
blocks.zh: 伪证:H3 H3(水印效应):部分拒绝——可见水印提供了显著的助推力(p=0.0075 p=0.0075,r=0.378 r=0.378),合成器是一种强大的独立信号(p=0.0020 p=0.0020,r=0.437 r=0.437),但仅本土结构动脉分析就实现了100%的检测,说明水印是补充性的,不是必需的.

blocks.en: 5. Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1. Revisiting the Research Question
blocks.zh: 5.1. 审查研究问题

blocks.en: This study addressed the following research question: can MLLMs function as reliable deepfake detectors of MLLM-generated images, and do their classifications and justifications reflect genuine reasoning or do they exploit shortcuts such as image watermarking?
blocks.zh: 这项研究涉及以下研究问题:MLLMs能否作为MLLM生成的图像的可靠深假探测器发挥作用,其分类和理由是否反映了真实的推理,或者它们是否利用了图像水印等捷径?

blocks.en: From the findings of this study, the answer remains partial. Same-ecosystem detection showed no consistent advantage as GPT-5.2 detected external Flux.2 Pro images better (87.9%) than its own GPT-Image-1.5 (72.1%), confirming that generator image quality matters more than whether the image is a product of the same ecosystem generator.
blocks.zh: 从这项研究的结论来看,答案仍然是部分的。 同生态系统探测显示没有一致的优势,因为GPT-5.2探测到外部流量。 Pro图像比它自己的GPT-Image-1.5(72.1%)更好(87.9%),确认生成者图像质量比图像是否是同一生态系统生成者的产品更重要.

blocks.en: Beyond the detection baseline, the most unexpected finding was the masking phenomenon in C5, a result that was never hypothesised and carries direct implications for watermark design.
blocks.zh: 在探测基线之外,最出人意料的发现是C5中的遮掩现象,这个结果从未被假设出来,并对水印设计有直接影响.

blocks.en: 5.2. Key Findings
blocks.zh: 5.2. 主要调查结果

blocks.en:
GPT-5.2 was the leading detector in every part of this study, achieving 78.8% accuracy in single-image analysis and 93.8% in the qualitative audit. GPT-5.2 demonstrated that it does not simply guess but rather identifies the right image artefacts within its justifications. This contrasts with GPT-4o which comes from the same family but scored 58.3% accuracy within the audit, suggesting forensic capability is more dependent on model generation than ecosystem membership. Since no consistent self-detection advantage was observed across the full 6×7 detector-generator matrix, H1 is only partially supported within this study.
The “Gemini pairwise paradox” was the study’s most unexpected result. Gemini 2.5’s accuracy reduced by 17.1%, falling below the random chance threshold of 50%, when a real photo was presented alongside the generated one. This suggests that, for certain AI architectures, a second image actually creates “comparison noise” which can confuse the model rather than assisting it.
blocks.zh:
GPT-5.2是本研究每个部分的主要探测器,单像分析的精确度达到78.8%,质量审计的精确度达到93.8%. GPT-5.2表明,它不只是猜测,而是在其理由中确定正确的图像手工艺品。 这与GPT-4o形成对比,GPT-4o来自同一家族,但在审计中得分为58.3%,这表明法证能力更多地依赖于模型生成而不是生态系统成员。 由于在完整的6×7探测器-生成器矩阵上没有观察到一致的自我探测优势,因此H1在本研究中仅得到部分支持.
“Gemini对等悖论”是研究中最出乎意料的结果。 双子座2.5的精度下降了17.1%,低于50%的随机机会阈值,而真实照片与生成的照片同时展示。 这表明,对于某些AI架构来说,第二个图像实际上会产生“比较噪音”,从而可能混淆模型而不是协助模型。

blocks.en:
Experiment 3 provided clarity on the effects of digital watermarking through the “ceiling effect”. Once both visible and invisible watermarks were stripped from the Gemini images, detection still reached 100%.
Detection at 100% even without any watermarks shows that Gemini is able to recognise its own generative artefacts.
blocks.zh:
实验3通过“上限效应”明确了数字水标记的效果。 一旦从双子座图像中剥去可见和看不见的水印,检测仍达到100%.
检测到100%,即使没有任何水印,也表明双子座能够识别自己的基因文物。

blocks.en: The C5 masking phenomenon was an unexpected finding. When SynthID was present but the visible logo removed (D3), detection fell to 90%, lower than the fully ablated control (D5) at 100%. An invisible watermark promoted as a detection tool is statistically associated with reduced detection accuracy ( p = 0.0020 p=0.0020 , r = 0.437 r=0.437 ) compared to images carrying no watermark at all and this directly challenges the idea of invisible watermarking systems. While embedding a signal into the image frequency ensures it survives cropping and compression ( Gowal et al., 2025 ) , it consequently modifies the high-frequency pixel structure that the MLLMs use for watermark detection. While previous researchers have discovered resistance to removal ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ) , this study demonstrates that watermarking systems can no longer be evaluated purely on their resistance to removal as a highly durable watermark is counterproductive if it accidentally hides the generative flaws needed to detect it as AI-generated.
blocks.zh: C5蒙面现象是一个意外发现. 当SynthID出现时,但可见的标志被移除(D3),检测率下降到90%,低于100%的完全减速控制(D5). 作为检测工具而推广的隐形水印在统计学上与检测精度的降低(p=0.0020p=0.0020,r=0.437r=0.437)相关,与完全没有水印的图像相比,这直接挑战了隐形水印系统的想法. 在将一个信号嵌入图像频率时,确保它能幸存下来的裁剪和压缩(Gowal等人,2025年),但MLLMs因此修改了用于水印检测的高频像素结构. 虽然之前的研究人员已经发现了对去除的阻力(Liu等人,2024年;Han等人,2025年),但本研究显示,如果水标记系统不小心隐藏了作为AI生成的检测所需的基因缺陷,则无法再仅仅评价其对去除的阻力,成为高度耐受水标记,则会产生反作用.

blocks.en: The absence of hallucinations across the six models within the Manual Justification Audit directly challenges the predictions of Sun et al. ( Sun et al., 2025 ) and Li et al. ( Li et al., 2025a ) . Within the literature it was believed that MLLMs would “hallucinate” forensic justifications when classifying images. This pattern was not observed in this study. Every incorrect classification was a justified misclassification, models were wrong; however their errors remained grounded in identifiable structural reasoning rather than made-up justifications.
blocks.zh: 《说明理由审计手册》内没有六个模型的幻觉直接挑战了Sun等人的预测。 (Sun等人,2025年)和Li等人著. (Li等人,2025a). 在文献中,人们相信,MLLMs在对图像进行分类时会“抹杀”法医理由。 这项研究没有观察到这种模式。 每一个错误的分类都是合理的错误分类,模型是错误的;然而,其错误仍然基于可识别的结构推理,而不是编造的理由。

blocks.en: 5.3. Relation to Existing Literature
blocks.zh: 5.3. 与现有文献的关系

blocks.en: Detection difficulty increased with each generation of generator architecture, with Gemini 3 images achieving a cross-model detection mean of 50.4%, close to the boundary of random chance. This directly reflects what Rombach et al. ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) and Rössler et al. ( Rössler et al., 2019 ) predicted: as generative architectures advance, detection strategies that once worked stop working. Liu et al. Liu et al. (2024) and Han et al. Han et al. (2025) also raised concerns about the fragility around image watermarking and this can be partially supported from the ablation study results. The C2 comparison showed that cropping a visible logo reduced detection from 100% to 90%, confirming that once visible markers are removed, images are more likely to be vulnerable to trivial attacks. However, the “ceiling effect” slightly contradicts this as detection remained at 100% even after all watermarks were removed.
blocks.zh: 检测难度随着每代生成器架构的增加而增加,双子座3图像实现跨模型检测平均值50.4%,接近随机机会的边界. 这直接反映了罗姆巴赫等人的观点. (Rombach等人,2022年)和罗斯勒等人. (Rössler等人,2019年) 预测:随着基因结构的推进,一度有效的检测策略停止了工作. 刘等. 刘等(2024年),韩等. Han等人(2025年)还对图像水标记的脆弱程度表示关切,这可以从消化研究的结果中得到部分支持。 C2对比显示,裁剪一个可见的标志将检测率从100%降低到90%,证实一旦清除可见的标志,图像更容易受到微不足道的攻击. 然而,“最高效应”与这一点略有矛盾,因为即使在所有水印被移除之后,探测率仍保持在100%。

blocks.en: Sun et al. Sun et al. (2025) and Li et al. Li et al. (2025a) predicted that MLLMs would fabricate justifications however the results do not align with the hallucination concerns raised in the literature. This gap highlights that current literature overestimates how common hallucinations are. It is highly likely that the studio-style, high-quality portraits used within this study do not trigger the hallucination errors. Alternatively, the result might simply show that newer model generations have genuinely improved, outgrowing the baseline reasoning flaws reported in older studies.
blocks.zh: 孙等. 孙等(2025年),李等. Li等人(2025年a)预测,MLLMs会编造理由,但结果与文献中提出的幻觉关切不符。 这一差距突出表明,目前的文献高估了常见的幻觉。 本研究中使用的录音室风格的优质肖像很可能不会引发幻觉错误. 或者,结果可能只是表明,较新的模范一代得到了真正的改进,超越了以往研究所报告的基线推理缺陷。

blocks.en: Similarly, the “Clever Hans” effect predicted by Maheronnaghsh and Alvanagh Maheronnaghsh and Alvanagh (2025) was only partially observed. While the visible watermarks definitely served as shortcuts for the detectors, the Manual Justification Audit demonstrates that models such as GPT-5.2 classify images through their structural reasoning.
blocks.zh: 同样,Maheronnaghsh和Alvanagh Maheronnaghsh和Alvanagh(2025年)预测的“Clever Hans”效应也只是部分观察到。 虽然可见的水印是探测器的捷径,但《说明理由手册审计》显示,GPT-5.2等模型通过结构推理对图像进行分类。

blocks.en: 5.4. Limitations of the Study
blocks.zh: 5.4. 研究的局限性

blocks.en: Whilst the dataset was designed to be demographically balanced, it relies exclusively on high-quality, studio style portraits from the FFHQ and state-of-the-art generative sources. In a real world forensic scenario, synthetic imagery often undergoes “post-generation degradation,” including adversarial noise, low-resolution cropping, or significant social media compression. It remains unclear whether the “semantic reasoning” proficiency of detectors such as GPT-5.2 would maintain this performance under true forensic settings.
blocks.zh: 虽然数据集的设计在人口结构上是平衡的,但它完全依靠来自FFHQ和最新基因来源的高质量、工作室风格的肖像。 在现实世界的法医学情景中,合成图像经常发生“生成后退化”,包括对抗性噪音、低分辨率裁剪或社交媒体压缩。 仍然不清楚的是,GPT-5.2等探测器的“语义推理”熟练度能否在真正的法医环境下保持这种性能。

blocks.en: The dataset of n=400 images is sufficient for a controlled comparison but small relative to the training corpus of the MLLMs themselves. This creates a risk that the accuracy results are based upon generative “flaws” in current versions of Gemini or GPT that might have been resolved by a larger dataset incorporating newer model versions.
blocks.zh: n=400图像的数据集足以进行有控制的比较,但相对于MLLMs本身的训练套件而言,它很小。 这造成一种风险,即准确性结果可能基于目前双子座或GBT版本中遗传性的“法则”,而这种法则可能已经通过纳入较新的模型版本的更大的数据集来解决。

blocks.en: Relying on the model’s own natural-language justifications introduces the “black box” problem. The internal logic the models use to reach those conclusions remains inaccessible which raises questions about the reliability of the justifications.
blocks.zh: 根据模型本身的自然语言理由,提出了 " 黑盒 " 问题。 用于得出这些结论的模型的内部逻辑仍然无法理解,这使人们对理由的可靠性产生疑问。

blocks.en: Another limitation within this study is that the FFHQ dataset itself could have been part of the training data for some of the MLLMs used within this study. This could mean detectors have prior exposure to control group images, potentially impacting accuracy.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的另一个局限是,FFHQ数据集本身可能是本研究中使用的一些MLLM的培训数据的一部分. 这可能意味着探测器事先接触控制组图象,有可能影响准确性。

blocks.en: Finally, the models selected were state-of-the-art at time of evaluation (December 2025), however, newer releases of the ecosystems have been released, raising questions about whether the specific accuracy figures reported here remain current.
blocks.zh: 最后,在评价时(2025年12月),所选模型是最新的,但生态系统的释放较新,令人怀疑此处报告的具体准确数字是否仍然有效。

blocks.en: 5.5. Future Work
blocks.zh: 5.5. 今后的工作

blocks.en: Within future work, the most immediate priority would be stress-testing MLLM detectors against lower-quality imagery. Future studies should implement datasets featuring heavy JPEG compression and noise injection to identify the specific threshold at which a model’s structural reasoning begins to fail. This would provide a more realistic assessment of how these models perform in “in-the-wild” forensic settings, where high-fidelity cues are often obscured. As this study provides empirical evidence of a masking effect within invisible watermarking, expanding the ablation corpus would confirm if these findings have direct implications for forensic watermark design.
blocks.zh: 在今后的工作中,最紧迫的优先事项将是对低质量图像进行压力测试的MLLM探测器。 未来的研究应当实施以重JPEG压缩和噪声注入为特征的数据集,以确定一个模型的结构推理开始失败的具体阈值. 这将更现实地评估这些模型在 " 万无一失 " 的法证环境中的表现,在这些环境中,高可信度的提示往往被掩盖。 由于本研究提供了隐形水印中掩盖作用的经验证据,扩展水印将确认这些结论是否直接影响到法证水印的设计。

blocks.en: A future priority is to address the qualitative gap within the pairwise analysis. A dedicated “Pairwise Reasoning Audit” should use “Ablated Anchors” (degraded reference images). This would reveal whether the performance drop within the tier 2 experiment results are a result of the image quality, or the models ability to perform pairwise detection.
blocks.zh: 今后的优先事项是在双向分析中解决质量差距。 专门进行的“对等理性审计”应使用“降级基准”。 这将揭示第二级实验结果中的性能下降是图像质量的结果,还是模型进行双向检测的能力。

blocks.en:
Additionally, future research should incorporate a human-baseline comparison to provide an insight into how the MLLMs and their justifications map against human forensic experts. Finally, to address any human bias within the Manual Justification Audit, future audits should employ multiple auditors to review the MLLMs justifications and then get the average for the final verdict. This would make the no-hallucination finding considerably harder to dismiss.
Comparison noise remains a proposed explanation rather than a confirmed mechanism. One alternative is that Gemini’s instruction-tuning causes it to assess visual differences between paired images differently than it processes a single image in isolation, a hypothesis that could be isolated by replacing the FFHQ control group image with a second synthetic image in a controlled follow-up experiment.
blocks.zh:
此外,今后的研究应纳入人与人的基线比较,以便深入了解MLLMs及其与人类法医专家对比的理由。 最后,为了解决《说明理由审计手册》中的任何人性偏见,今后的审计应雇用多名审计员审查小额供资和微型企业的理由,然后获得最后判决的平均数。 这将使无污名化的发现更难被撤销。
比较噪音仍然是一个拟议解释,而不是一个确认的机制。 一种方法是双子座的指令调制使其评估配对图像之间的视觉差异不同于它孤立地处理单个图像,这个假说可以通过在受控后续实验中用第二个合成图像取代FFHQ控制组图像来隔离.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6个 结论

blocks.en: Based on the results, structural reasoning proves more reliable for forensic detection than pixel-level or metadata-based approaches. While the “Gemini Paradox” and inconsistent performance accuracy across model generations show that these tools are not yet robust, the Manual Justification Audit proves that their ability to identify physical inconsistencies is a capability that improves meaningfully with model generation.
blocks.zh: 根据结果,结构推理被证明比像素级或基于元数据的方法更可靠地用于法证检测. 虽然“Gemini Paradox”和不同代模型的性能准确性不一致表明这些工具尚不健全,但《说明理由审计手册》证明,它们识别物理不一致的能力是一种随着模型生成而有意义的改进能力。

blocks.en:
While MLLMs should not yet replace human forensic experts, they do provide auditable natural-language justifications for each classification decision, which differentiates them from traditional CNN detectors.
The masking phenomenon identified within this study demonstrates that the forensic community should reevaluate how invisible watermarking systems are used, not only for their durability against adversarial attacks but also for their impact on the structural signals that many MLLM detectors depend upon.
blocks.zh:
虽然MLLMS还不应该取代人类法医专家,但是它们的确为每个分类决定提供了可审计的自然语言理由,从而区别于传统的CNN探测器.
本研究查明的遮掩现象表明,法医界应重新评价如何使用隐形水印系统,这不仅是为了防止对抗性攻击的耐久性,而且也是为了对许多MLLM探测器所依赖的结构信号产生影响。
